description: This file defines a class 'Translation' within the OpenCart framework's catalog controller event namespace. It handles translation functionalities by loading translation models and setting translation keys and values in the language object during certain trigger events.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing translation data during specific events in the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the translation loading process during its trigger, fetching translations for a route and setting them into the language object, optionally with a prefix.
